FAQ

ChatGPT plugins: common questions

What is the ChatGPT Plugins Directory?
chatgptplugins.directory is an independent, community-run directory of ChatGPT plugins, the apps inside them and the MCP servers that power them. Every listing is reviewed before it goes live, with install steps written from the publisher's documented setup. It is not affiliated with OpenAI.How listings are chosen

Do ChatGPT plugins still exist?
Yes, as something new. The original 2023 plugins shut down in April 2024. On July 9, 2026, OpenAI replaced the App Directory with the Plugin Directory, and a ChatGPT plugin is now a package of apps, skills and app templates that works in both ChatGPT and Codex.The full timeline

How do I install a ChatGPT plugin?
Open the Plugins tab in ChatGPT (or chatgpt.com/plugins), open the plugin's page and select the plus button. Connect the outside account if asked, then start a new chat: a plugin's tools only appear in chats started after you install it.Step-by-step guide

What's the difference between plugins, apps and MCP servers?
A plugin is what you install. Inside it are apps that connect ChatGPT to a service, skills that teach it a workflow, and templates to start from. Every app runs on an MCP server, and you can connect your own MCP servers directly in developer mode.Read the explainer

How are plugins ranked in this directory?
Rankings combine official status, open-source traction, completeness of the listing and recency. Nobody can pay for a higher rank, and sponsored placements are always labelled.

For agents

This directory speaks MCP.

Add it to ChatGPT, Codex or any agent and ask it to find the right plugin. Every page is also available as Markdown, and the whole site is indexed in llms.txt.

MCP endpoint · Streamable HTTP · no auth

https://chatgptplugins.directory/api/mcp

# Codex
codex mcp add plugins-directory --url https://chatgptplugins.directory/api/mcp

# any page as Markdown
curl https://chatgptplugins.directory/plugins/github.md
